title: Olu nke Nnupụisi
intro: Ogologo oge tupu mmadụ mbụ ebie ụwa, otu onye nwere ike dị ukwuu guzoro n'ebe udo zuru oke, nke mkpụrụ obi kacha raara onwe ya nye gbara gburugburu. Mgbe e nyere otu iwu, olu ọ bụla kpọrọ isi ala n'okpuru—mana otu olu biliri n'okpuru, nnupụisi ahụ ga-ada ụda ruo ọgbọ niile ruo ụbọchị ikpeazụ. Ònye bụ onye a dara ada?
clues: E ji ihe na-ere ọkụ nke ọma kee m, ebe ndị ọzọ nọ m n'akụkụ ka e ji ihe ha jere ije kpụọ.
Ebi m n'ebe dị nsọ n'etiti ndị e ji obi ha niile na-efe Chineke, ruo mgbe otu iwu gbanwere ihe niile.
Mgbe iwu ahụ bịara, mkpụrụ obi niile kpọrọ isiala ma e wezụga maka m; ọjụjụ m sitere na mpako.
A chụpụrụ m n'ebe nsọ ahụ, e jiri ọbụbụ ọnụ nke ga-adịru mgbe ebighị ebi kaa m akara.
Arịọrọ m oge ruo ụbọchị mbilite n'ọnwụ, e wee nye ya. Ekwere m nkwa ịgakwuru mkpụrụ obi ọ bụla ma duhie ha.
Mgbe opi ahụ dara, ndị so m ga-eso m kerịta akara aka m, soro m n'ọkụ na-ere ọkụ ebe onye enyemaka ọ bụla agaghị azọpụta ha.

identity.label: Ònye ka m bụ?
options: Iblis
Fero (Fir'aw)
Namrud
Abu Lahab
Azar (nna Ibrahim)

trial.label: Oge Nkọwapụta
options: Ịjụ ịkpọ isiala nye Adam
Iji chi mee ihe n'alaeze ukwu
A na-eme atụmatụ ịtụba onye ezi omume n'ọkụ
Iduzi ndị mmadụ ife ihe oyiyi ọlaedo ofufe
Imikpu nnukwu usuu ndị agha n'oké osimiri

location.label: Ebe Nsọ ahụ
options: Paradaịs (Jannah)
Obí mara mma dị n'akụkụ Osimiri Naịl
Ụlọ elu brik nke na-eru elu n'eluigwe
Nwa ehi ọlaedo e ji ihe ịchọ mma kpụọ
Ọkụ ọkụ nke ọkụ na-ere ọkụ

outcome.label: Akara Aka Ikpeazụ
options: Achụpụ ya, na-ezu ike ruo ụbọchị e kwere nkwa
Mmiri riri ndị agha n'okpuru ebili mmiri
Nkume ndị e si n'eluigwe tụba gwepịara ya
Ụmụ nnụnụ na-efe efe gbawara agbawa
O jiri otu mgbawa dị ike rie ya
outcome.answer: Achụpụ ya, na-ezu ike ruo ụbọchị e kwere nkwa

arabic: قَالَ أَرَءَيْتَكَ هَـٰذَا ٱلَّذِى كَرَّمْتَ عَلَىَّ لَئِنْ أَخَّرْتَنِ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ لَأَحْتَنِكَنَّ ذُرِّيَّتَهُۥٓ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا
verse: [Iblees] said, "Do You see this one whom You have honored above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few." (17:62)
